g.text: JJA · Latent heat flux and 10 m wind anomalies
8 El Niño events / 9 development years · ERSSTv5 SST · ERA5 wind · NCEP-NCAR R1 latent heat flux
1991–2020 calendar-month anomalies; no detrending or ENSO removal. Box: 10–30°N, 155–115°W (ocean only).
Arrows show wind anomalies, not actual wind. 2014 and 2015 belong to one event. Identical scales across MAM and JJA.
